manifest.method: recorded Trader and Context Analyst outputs, real PM PydanticAI API and deterministic GM

assumptions.funding: not modeled (zero); net results exclude funding
assumptions.execution: recorded pending stops activate only on a complete M1 candle opened after intent availability, with strict crossing and close beyond trigger; invalidation wins same-bar ambiguity; MARKET at observed M1 close plus adverse slippage after existing GM validation; original intent is preserved, expiry uses existing max_intent_age_ms
assumptions.barriers: subsequent full M1 bars; stop first if both barriers touched; partial entry minute excluded
assumptions.latency: source decisions and contexts become available at their original simulation completion times; PM API latency advances simulation
assumptions.venue_rules: simulation assumptions: ETH step/min 0.001, minimum notional 5, leverage 5
assumptions.evaluation: retrospective replay, not a prospective out-forward; no parameter optimization
assumptions.pending_cancellation: invalidation, expiry or a newer same-symbol ENTER cancels a pending candidate; NO_TRADE does not cancel an earlier candidate
assumptions.long_exit_policy: lock_and_wait_nonnegative_net: no automatic LONG stop or time-limit exit; observed closed M1 stop touch requests full hedge through existing GM; MAIN close/reduction blocked if projected MAIN+HEDGE liquidation net is negative; SHORT MAIN barriers unchanged; management horizon is finite

market_context.regime: H4 bull-trend (channel) with an unconfirmed reversal candidate; M15/H1 in a tight 12-bar range at the low of a strong bear breakout

trigger.reference: M15 bar 119 high (bull reversal bar at the range low)

invalidation.reference: M15 bar 109 low - pullback double-bottom low

evidence_for: Broader structure is a bull trend on H4 (current context): bars 111-112 closed near their highs (2578.60 of a 2585.50 high; 2636.28 of a 2643.52 high) and the break above 2537.57/2544.63/2609.02 held above 2604.75 for eight bars to 2700.00 (bar 116 high); the last raw close 2577.06 is still above the H4 pre-breakout top 2544.63 (context, not a vote).

The M15 pullback came back to the prior H1 breakout base and held: M15 bar 109 (open_time 1789874100000) low 2569.8 versus H1 bar 81 (open_time 1789743600000) low 2569.16 and high 2585.5; H1 bar 117 (open_time 1789873200000) open 2572.94, low 2569.8, close 2586.68 - a bull reversal bar closing back above 2585.5.

After the M15 bear spike bar 107 (open 2603.75, low 2571, close 2573.13) there is no new low: bars 108 and 109 set 2570.27 and 2569.8, and the last three lows are 2574.41 (bar 117), 2573.82 (bar 118), 2574.18 (bar 119) with no close below 2573.13 - a double bottom that keeps holding.

M15 bar 119 (open_time 1789883100000) open 2574.40, high 2577.99, low 2574.18, close 2577.06 is a bull reversal bar closing near its high that reverses bar 118's bear bar (open 2577.21, low 2573.82, close 2574.40) at the low of the 12-bar range 2569.8-2594.57.

Location and equation: the pending stop sits in the lower third of a 24.77-point tight range, 8.19 above the structural low 2569.8, while the first resistance at 2594.57 (bars 108/109 high) is 16.58 away.
evidence_against: Strongest counter: the large recent bars are bear breakouts that broke structure - M15 bar 107 (open 2603.75, low 2571, close 2573.13) and H1 bar 116 (open 2617.83, low 2571, close 2573.13) closed near their lows well below the H1/H4 7-bar range low 2604.75, so the 12-bar M15 range is at least as easily read as a bear flag, and the first reversal attempt after such a spike often fails with a second leg down.

The range's highs keep falling: 2594.57 (bars 108/109), 2587.03 (110), 2586.73 (112), 2585.39 (113), 2583.44 (116/117), 2580.56 (118), 2577.99 (119) - the 2577.99 trigger must clear three lower highs before the 2594.57 top is even tested.

H1 bar 119 (open 2578.56, low 2573.82, close 2577.06) closed below H1 bar 118's low 2578.33, so the newest H1 close is bearish and under the prior bar's low; the H4 context's last close 2586.68 predates these two H1 closes.

H4 context flags a buy climax: bar 116's 2700.00 exceeded 2680.00 by only 20.00 and closed 61.51 below its high, and its final bar closed under the 7-bar range low 2604.75 and under the lows of bars 113-119; this long is the first pullback of a possibly unconfirmed MTR, with 2537.57-2544.63 as deeper support.
The entry is not the range's extreme low (2569.8) and no bull breakout above 2594.57 has occurred, so the stop can be filled while the 12-bar range is still undecided.
uncertainty: The 12-bar M15 range 2569.8-2594.57 has not resolved; a break below 2569.8 (bear flag) and a break above 2594.57 (bull flag) are both live.
The buy stop at 2577.99 is pending and untriggered at the 2577.06 close; if price closes below 2569.8 first the setup is void.

The H4 context's content ends at the H1 bar 117 close 2586.68 (as-of 1789876799999) and excludes H1 bars 118-119 (closes 2580.35, 2577.06), so its bullish 'final close above 2585.50' point is older than the raw bars.

The 2700.00 buy climax with a 61.51 upper tail raises the chance the pullback extends toward 2537.57-2544.63 before any resumption, which would invalidate this entry even if the larger trend stays up.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close below 2569.8 (bar 109 low) breaks the pullback's double bottom and voids the long; next references are the H4 pre-breakout top 2544.63/2537.57 and then 2495.82.
Acceptance above 2594.57 (bars 108/109 high) confirms the range as a bull flag and puts 2604.75 and 2643.52 in play.
Two consecutive M15 closes below 2569.8 would confirm the bear flag and shift the read toward the H4 range breakdown described in the H4 transition conditions.
If price makes a lower high under 2577.99 and closes below 2573.82 (bar 118 low) without triggering, the bull signal is stale and the 12-bar range reads as a bear flag.
